desktopNotSupported: This app is designed for mobile devices.
installAppDescription: Add this app to your home screen.
installAppUnavailable: Use your browser menu, then “Add to Home Screen”.
updateAppDescription: Fetch the newest version and reload.
appLockDescription: Ask for your fingerprint before opening.
appLockUnsupported: No fingerprint unlock on this device.
appLockFailed: Setting up the lock did not work.
unlockFailed: That did not work. Try again.
eraseDataWarningDescription: Your data is encrypted and can only be read with a working fingerprint unlock. Since that isn't available right now, turning off the lock permanently erases it — there is no way to recover it afterwards.
importCsvSummary: Imported {imported}, updated {updated}, skipped {skipped} unchanged, {invalid} invalid rows.
importCsvFailed: That file has no Artist and Title columns.
emptyDescription: Import your list from a CSV file, or tap + to find an album.
searchAlbumHint: Type an artist, a title or both — tap a result to add it.
addManually: Not there? Add it by hand
deleteAlbumDescription: It's removed from your collection for good.
albumNotFound: This album doesn't exist any more.
appLockNotice: A convenience lock only — it does not encrypt your albums.
appLockEncryptedNotice: Your albums are encrypted with a key derived from your fingerprint. If it stops working, they cannot be recovered — export a backup as insurance.
importCsvDescription: Add albums from a spreadsheet saved as CSV. Albums you already have keep their covers, but get the status from the file.
restoreDescription: Bring back the albums saved before the last update.
updateConfirmDescription: The app reloads. Your albums are backed up first.
exportDataDescription: Save a backup file of your whole collection.
importDataDescription: Replace your collection with a backup file.
importFailed: That file isn't an albums backup.
importDescription: Every album on this device is replaced by the backup's. This can't be undone.
coversNotice: Covers are downloaded once from their URLs and kept on this device (encrypted with the lock), so they show offline. They aren't part of backups.
findCoversDescription: Look up covers, missing years and links to your streaming service.
findCoversIntro: Searches MusicBrainz for every album missing a cover, a year or a link to your streaming service, then iTunes for covers (and Apple Music links) still missing — only its artist and title are sent. The first result with the same artist and title is filled in for you, plain releases before deluxe or remastered ones; only albums without a cover and with nothing like that wait below for you to pick. About one album a second.
lookupFailed: Couldn't reach the cover service. Check your connection and try again — what was found is kept.
sourceRateLimited: {source}: too many requests — try again in a minute.
streamingServiceDescription: Where album links lead, and which links are looked up.
githubSyncDescription: Keep your albums in a JSON file in your own private GitHub repository.
githubNeedsEncryption: Syncing with GitHub needs the app lock with encryption (Security above): the access token is only ever stored encrypted.
githubTokenHint: A fine-grained token for this repository only, with Contents: read and write.
githubConnected: Connected to GitHub. Sync to bring both sides together.
githubSyncDonePushed: Synced. Here: {added} added, {updated} updated, {removed} removed. Changes saved to GitHub.
githubSyncDoneUpToDate: Synced. Here: {added} added, {updated} updated, {removed} removed. GitHub was already up to date.
githubDisconnectDescription: Removes the token from this phone. The file on GitHub stays.
githubErrorUnauthorized: GitHub rejected the token, or it has no access to this repository.
githubErrorNotFound: No such repository or branch, or the token can't see it.
githubErrorConflict: The file kept changing on GitHub. Try again in a moment.
githubErrorRateLimited: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Try again in a while.
githubErrorNetwork: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your connection.
githubErrorUnexpected: Something went wrong with GitHub. Nothing was changed.
githubErrorFile: The file on GitHub has albums the app can't read. Nothing was changed.
